title: Integrability of a Normalized Rademacher Coordinate
statement: For every natural number $n$, coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and exponent $p\in[0,\infty]$, the function on the sign cube given by the $i$th sign multiplied by $1/\sqrt n$ belongs to $L^p$ for the uniform probability measure on that cube.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is an extended nonnegative real exponent
